questionText:
Arrange the sequential steps in developing a systematic career plan in Home Science:
(A) Self-assessment of personal interests, values, and aptitudes
(B) Exploring academic options and vocational training courses
(C) Acquiring targeted professional skills and domain certifications
(D) Entering employment or entrepreneurship and pursuing lifelong skill advancement

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: B, A, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Inverts the governing property or boundary condition.

options.text: A, B, C, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies the chronological/logical progression.

options.text: A, C, B, D
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Applies an adjacent or reciprocal mathematical relation.

options.text: D, B, C, A
options.mistakeAnalysis: Incorrect option. Confuses related NCERT concepts or attributes.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
Career planning progresses from self-assessment (A) to educational exploration (B) to specialized skill acquisition (C) to professional practice and advancement (D).
Hence, Option A is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.

questionText:
Arrange the correct sequence of ergonomic adjustments for setting up a computer desk and chair:
(A) Adjust chair seat height so feet rest flat on the floor with knees bent at a 90-degree angle
(B) Position lumbar backrest support firmly against the inward curve of the lower spine
(C) Adjust desk height so forearms rest horizontal with elbows relaxed at 90-100 degrees
(D) Place computer monitor at eye level or slightly below, at an arm's distance (50-70 cm)

Choose the correct chronological/logical sequence from the options given below:

options.text: D, B, C, A

Hence, Option B is correct.
